Factory Acceptance Test – Protocol and Report
Mechanical
Document no. FAT-TP201-M
Revision 0
Issue date 12-Jan-2026
Equipment TP-201 – Rotary tablet press (single-sided)
Serial no. RTP36-25-0417
Manufacturer Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH
1. Purpose
This document defines and records the factory acceptance tests (mechanical) of the rotary tablet press (single-sided) at the manufacturer's works, before shipment to the customer.
2. Approval before execution
Role Name Company Signature Date
Prepared by Markus Brandt Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH Signed electronically 12-Jan-2026
Checked by Bayu Pratama Customer (site) Signed electronically 22-Jan-2026
Approved by Dewi Anggraini Customer (site) Signed electronically 22-Jan-2026
3. Test results
Pass/Fail is recorded against the acceptance criterion of each step.
Step Test Acceptance criterion Result Pass/ Fail
FAT-M-01 Count the punch stations on the turret. ≥ 36 stations 36 stations Pass
FAT-M-02 Run the empty turret across its speed range; record the lowest and highest stable speed. 20–60 rpm 20–60 rpm Pass
FAT-M-03 Apply main compression with the test tooling; record the highest force reached. ≥ 100 kN 96 kN Pass
FAT-M-04 Fit tooling for the largest tablet diameter and run 5 minutes. ≤ 25 mm 25 mm Pass
FAT-M-05 Set the maximum fill cam; measure the fill depth. ≤ 18 mm 18 mm Pass
FAT-M-06 Measure surface roughness Ra on product-contact parts. ≤ 0.8 µm 0.6 µm Pass
FAT-M-07 Check frame and cover material against the bill of materials. SS 304 SS 304 Pass
FAT-M-08 Check the main compression force channel against a reference load cell. ≤ 1 % FS 0.5 % FS Pass
FAT-M-09 Run the paddle feeder across its speed range; record the lowest and highest speed. 20–60 rpm 20–60 rpm Pass
FAT-M-10 Remove and refit product-contact parts without tools. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
FAT-M-11 Check that operating and maintenance manuals are supplied. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
FAT-M-12 Check 3.1 material certificates for all product-contact parts. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
FAT-M-13 Check calibration certificates of the compression force sensors. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
